events.title: Online Support Services
events.description: We are a small group of volunteers who provide a friendly face-to-face service for clients who have difficulty with online forms, services and email. We are not an advice service, however we will endeavor to help you with: • Applying for Blue Badges, Oyster 60+ travel card, Freedom Passes and Taxi Cards. • Applying for Housing Benefit, Universal Credit, PIP, Disability Living Allowance, Free School Meals and Attendance Allowance. • Council Tax issues and help to understand decisions on benefits, passports, etc. Free one-hour appointments are available on Tuesdays 10-1pm, Thursdays 10-1pm, and fortnightly Saturdays 10-1pm. Please book your appointment either in person or by telephoning 020 8378 5358. If you are unable to attend your appointment, we would be grateful if you would cancel as soon as possible. “I have found the services very useful. It has been a lifesaver with some of the problems I’ve had. Thank you”. Vivian

events.title: ESOL – Beginner & Entry 1
events.description: Beginner Literacy, beginner ESOL & Entry 1 on Tuesdays from 1-3pm ESOL Levels explained Beginner: For those who are new to English and are just beginning to speak, read, and write. Entry Level 1: Can use and understand simple language for basic needs and travel. Entry Level 2: Can handle simple, routine tasks and express feelings with increasing confidence. Entry Level 3:: Can hold conversations on familiar topics and write more complex texts. Classes are free and students are given an initial assessment and a diagnostic test to ensure they can access the correct class. We attempt to prepare course materials for most levels. Classes are student cantered, encouraging input into the scheme of work. The library facilities and staff support the program with much welcomed voluntary help and use of a photocopier. The atmosphere is friendly and quiet, and a perfect place to learn and make friends. ESOL Entry 2 & Entry 3 on Thursday from 10-12pm

events.title: Lewisham Community Acupuncture
events.description: Low-cost Community Acupuncture at the Corbett Library from £30 per 60-minute appointment. Supporting clients to enjoy vibrant health. Conditions treated include: All pain conditions, fertility, gastro-intestinal disorders, insomnia, anxiety and mental health issues, auto-immune conditions, skin disorders, sports injury and recovery, gynaecological health, and quality of life in old age. Our goal is to help clients to manage or resolve the issue that has brought them to the clinic as quickly as possible. If they wish to keep coming for ongoing support or for wellness, then we are happy for them to do so. Reviews from Google: Lani Rory is a great acupuncturist; he has a very gentle and holistic approach. It’s amazing to find such quality treatment for such an affordable price. You can tell he does it because he’s passionate about it and cares for people’s health and wellbeing. I can’t recommend Lewisham Community Acupuncture enough! Eva I was in so much Sciatica pain and living on painkillers with hardly any sleep. I felt disabled. I tried acupuncture and Rory was great, very professional, respectable and listened. I visit once a week. After 2 weeks I realised that there was progress that my pain was not always there and then every week I felt better. It took 2 months literally 8 sessions and I feel restored and grateful to Rory. The treatment worked for me, and I thoroughly recommend his service

events.description: I'm Julie, a Reiki Master and crystal therapist based in South East London. I'm passionate about helping others feel more balanced, relaxed, and supported through gentle, natural healing. Reiki and crystals have made such a positive difference in my own life and family, and I love sharing that with others. I've used Reiki for many years to support my son's wellbeing, which has deepened my belief in its calming and nurturing benefits. events.title: Mixed Ability Pilates
events.description: The main focus of the Pilates classes are to improve core strength, flexibility, joint mobility and strength. They are designed to build more body awareness in order to achieve better movement patterns and a pain free body. It's physical and mental body conditioning, that releases tension and promotes relaxation. We also work on improving balance, coordination and posture through progressive moves that have a natural Dance element. Pilates helps improve flexibility, posture and strength, in short it improves the way you move which in turn helps you to live a better life. During my classes I try to cater to everybody's needs, by providing adaptions and progressions for each exercise in a warm and friendly environment. I am a fully qualified level 3 Mat based Pilates instructor who is also pre and postnatally trained and has taught Pilates for over 8 years. Come and revive your body and core strength through flowing functional movement using Mat based exercises and bands, balls and blocks. £10 drop in, £8 if booked for term Term time only

events.title: Artist PechaKucha
events.description: Join us for an inspiring evening of creativity, conversation and community at our first ever PechaKucha themed Artist Meet Up. Never been to a PechaKucha before? It’s a fun, fast-paced presentation format where each speaker shows 20 images for 20 seconds each. That means every talk lasts just 6 minutes and 40 seconds — keeping presentations engaging, energetic and full of surprises. Whether you’re an artist and would like some friendly critique of your work, an art lover or simply curious about the creative talent in the local area, come along to discover new work, hear the stories behind it, and meet other members of the local creative community. We will be running a reasonably priced bar and anyone who presents on the night will get a drink on us! If you would like to present at the PechaKucha please email us at info@corbettcommunity.org.uk no later than Friday 9 October. Here’s a template of a PechaKucha presentation for you to download and use for your own presentation. This event is a great warm-up to our upcoming Art Auction, happening on Friday 30 October, offering a chance to get to know some of the artists whose work helps make our local creative scene so vibrant. Tickets for the PechaKucha are FREE, but spaces are limited, so please book your ticket here.

events.title: The Public Good: A contextual history of the Corbett Community Library
events.description: We are delighted to welcome Jon Wright, Chair of the Archibald Corbett Society, who will share a fascinating insight into Andrew Carnegie, his philosophy and the architectural legacy that our library is part of. An architectural historian by training, Jon has previously worked for the Twentieth Century Society, The Council for British Archaeology and the War Memorials Trust. Jon is an active member in the Working Party of DOCOMOMO UK which seeks to further understanding and debate internationally about modern architecture in the UK. He also teaches on the Cambridge MSc Building History programme on Modern Movement buildings. He is currently writing his first book on the architecture of Mervyn Seal ARIBA. Jon has expertise around the architectural history of and the conservation issues affecting twentieth century buildings - with a further specialism in post-war architectural history. We will be running a reasonably priced bar. Doors open at 6.30pm and the talk starts at 7pm. Tickets for this talk are FREE but spaces are limited so please book your ticket here.

events.description: Da Mans Dem is a timeless comedy classic by poet-playwright Alan Charles, following the experiences of four male friends as they navigate love, sex, and relationships. In this bold and entertaining production, the men get the chance to talk their talk and tell their truth, exploring questions around love, identity, and what it really means to be a man. Unapologetic and honest, the brothers share their perspectives on what men want, why some men cheat, and how masculinity is defined. It’s raw. It’s fearless. It’s their truth. [Main Theatre]

events.description: The ultimate celebration of Musical Theatre. Following the overwhelming sell-out success of their 'Phantoms of the Popera' tour in 2025 and 2026, G4 have extended the tour into 2027. [Main Theatre]
